_about: Mail-rule cases (specs/fortress_mobile_apps.md § R14). Each case: rules as mailbox/device_rules lists them ({id, match: {from, to, subject, has_words, excludes, size_op: "" | "gt" | "lt", size_bytes, has_attachment}}, in the order the server evaluates them), a message {sender, recipient, subject, body_plain, body_html, size_bytes, has_attachment}, and expected_ids: the ids InboundEmailFilter::matches() accepts, in the order given (written by plugins/mailbox/tests/port_vectors_test.php from the PHP code, PORT_VECTORS_WRITE=1). has_attachment is true when the parse found any part at all. Case folding is PHP mb_strtolower (full Unicode lower-case mapping, no locale).
